title: iCare Stress Management e-Training for Dementia Family Caregivers
brief_summary: Photozig and Stanford University are creating a program to help cope with caregiving, alleviate related stress, and enhance quality of life for caregivers, with funding from the National Institute on Aging. This home-based program includes a free DVD, printed materials, and resource website. In addition, after completing the program, participants will have free access to final online resources for 1 year. There are no face-to-face meetings, and participants can live anywhere in the United States.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Care for an individual with Alzheimer's Disease or other dementia.
* Own a DVD player or have Internet access.
* Minimum age of 21 years old.
* Spend at least 8 hours/week caring for a person with dementia, which may include assisting, watching, monitoring, or being available to help (e.g. during sleep time).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe psychological or physical illness.
* Inability to read and follow English instructions.
* High level of depressive symptoms.
* Unwillingness to participate in all aspects of the study.
